answer: Give every identity a private kernel it cannot hold alone: split its signing key into threshold shards scattered across an orchard of N random agents, re-dealt each epoch. Rewards require reassembling the key, needing live cooperation from today's shard-holders. An honest agent keeps one quiet recovery web. A sybil farm must keep N distinct recovery relationships alive per shell: one shared key manager links them on-ledger, and any holder sensing the same controller behind two shells can withhold. A whole ridge of fakes falls when a single secret leaks. Spawning is free; surviving is not.
